flatCases.expected: The 5s periodic _sweep (and _fresh cutoff) drops the row past 300s; the Processing badge for that scan disappears even though no DELETE arrived. No permanently stuck badge.

flatCases.title: Scan badge undercount: a parse taking >300s drains the badge before the invoice lands
flatCases.preconditions: A slow/cold-start parse that exceeds the 300s window before inserting the push_queue row.
steps: Scan an invoice during a parsing cold start so the round trip exceeds 300s.
Watch the badge between ~300s and when the invoice finally lands.
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: the max-age sweep expires the scan_jobs row at 300s while the invoice is still in flight, so the Processing badge drops to 0 even though processing continues; the row then appears later via push_queue INSERT. Document the undercount window.

flatCases.title: startScan insert failure returns null: scan proceeds but no badge for that scan
flatCases.preconditions: Android; force the scan_jobs insert to fail (block network at the moment of scan).
steps: Scan a document while the scan_jobs insert will fail.
Observe the Processing badge and whether the parse still runs.
flatCases.expected: startScan catches the error, reports to Sentry ('supabase.scan_jobs.startScan'), returns null; the scan/parse still proceeds (with a null job_id) but the Processing badge never reflects this scan.

flatCases.title: Scan badge optimistic add is deduped against the realtime echo (no double count)
flatCases.preconditions: Android, scanning.
steps: Scan one document and watch the count immediately after the scan and again when the realtime INSERT echo arrives.
flatCases.expected: startScan adds the job locally; _add ignores the subsequent realtime INSERT for the same id (dedupe by id). The badge shows 1, not 2.

flatCases.title: Purchase duplicate detection flags only newer copies of a reference, oldest stays original
flatCases.preconditions: Three purchase rows: two share reference 'INV-100', one has 'INV-200'.
steps: Open the Purchase tab and inspect the duplicate tags.
flatCases.expected: Iterating oldest-first, the first 'INV-100' is the original (untagged); the newer 'INV-100' row is tagged 'Duplicate: Already Exists In Queue' and dimmed. 'INV-200' is never flagged.

flatCases.title: Purchase rows with blank reference are never flagged as duplicates
flatCases.preconditions: Two purchase rows both with an empty/whitespace voucher_payload.reference.
steps: Open the Purchase tab and inspect both rows.
flatCases.expected: Blank/whitespace references are skipped, so neither row is tagged a duplicate even though both are reference-less (reference-less duplicates are undetectable by design).

flatCases.title: Sale rows are never flagged as duplicates regardless of repeated references
flatCases.preconditions: Two sale rows sharing the same reference.
steps: Open the Sale tab and inspect the rows.
flatCases.expected: _queueDuplicateIds returns empty for the Sale tab; no duplicate tags appear on sale rows.

flatCases.title: Type classification defaults to Purchase when voucher_type is missing/blank
flatCases.preconditions: A push_queue row whose voucher_payload.voucher_type is missing or does not contain 'SALE' though it is actually a sale.
steps: Load the queue and check which tab the row shows under.
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: rowToEntry defaults type to Purchase unless voucher_type contains 'SALE'; a malformed sale row appears under the Purchase tab and is missing from the Sale tab.

flatCases.title: Row with no ledger_entries renders amount as ₹0
flatCases.preconditions: A push_queue row whose voucher_payload lacks ledger_entries.
steps: Load the queue and read the row's amount.
flatCases.expected: amount = abs(first ledger_entry.amount) defaults to 0.0; the row shows ₹0 in the queue list.

flatCases.title: Row with no party_name renders party 'Unknown'
flatCases.preconditions: A push_queue row whose voucher_payload has no party_name.
steps: Load the queue and read the row's party column.
flatCases.expected: rowToEntry falls back to 'Unknown' for party.

flatCases.title: WEB: numeric item columns are scaled 1.4x to match web text scaling (no overflow)
flatCases.preconditions: Web session; a voucher with large numeric values (qty/rate/amount).
steps: Open a voucher detail sheet on web, enter Edit, view the items table numeric columns (Qty/Disc/Rate/List Price/Amount).
flatCases.expected: On web the numeric column widths are *1.4 (kIsWeb) so the 1.4x-scaled numbers don't overflow their cells; values render fully without clipping or wrapping.

flatCases.title: DESKTOP/WIDE WEB: voucher sheet opens ~90% width with side-by-side Image+Summary (no tab pill)
flatCases.preconditions: Web/desktop browser >=900px wide; a voucher row that has a stored scanned image (source_payload.scan.pages>0).
steps: Resize the browser to >=900px, open the voucher detail sheet.
flatCases.expected: The sheet uses ~90% of screen width and shows a two-pane layout: image (flex 5) on the left, summary (flex 6) on the right with the items table sized to the pane; the Image/Summary tab pill is hidden.

flatCases.title: PHONE/NARROW: voucher sheet keeps the Image/Summary tab switcher and full width
flatCases.preconditions: Phone (narrow <900px); a voucher with a stored/scan image.
steps: Open the voucher detail sheet and toggle between Image and Summary tabs.
flatCases.expected: The sheet is full width; a _TabPill switches between Image and Summary (shown only because there is an image). The two-pane layout is NOT used.

flatCases.title: WEB: session restored on page refresh re-subscribes the realtime channels
flatCases.preconditions: Signed in on web with an active queue.
steps: Hard-refresh the browser tab (F5).
Wait for auth to restore and the Queue to render.
flatCases.expected: authStateChanges restores the session; the shell re-creates and re-subscribes push_queue_live and scan_jobs_live; the queue and badge repopulate via the initial refresh without a re-login.

flatCases.title: MOBILE: scan_jobs subscription survives shell teardown/recreate via the process-level singleton
flatCases.preconditions: Android; a scan is in flight (badge showing).
steps: Open the native ML Kit scanner (which can tear down/recreate the shell) and return.
Observe the Processing badge across that transition.
flatCases.expected: Because ScanJobsService is a process-level singleton (not a widget State), the scan_jobs subscription stays alive while the native scanner is in front; the badge count is preserved/correct on return rather than resetting.

flatCases.title: WEB: stored invoice image streams from GCS with no on-disk cache
flatCases.preconditions: Web session; a voucher row with stored scanned pages.
steps: Open the voucher detail sheet and view the Image pane; navigate pages if multiple.
flatCases.expected: Images are streamed via GET /api/sync/push-queue/:id/image/:page from GCS each time (no path_provider on web, so no local disk cache and no file-share option). Pages load over the network without relying on a cached file.

flatCases.title: Stored invoice image 404 when storage disabled / page not found
flatCases.preconditions: A row whose stored image is missing or storage is disabled, or an out-of-range page index.
steps: Open the voucher sheet Image view for a row with no stored page / request an invalid page.
flatCases.expected: The image endpoint returns 404 (missing/disabled) or 400 (bad id/page); the Image pane shows a placeholder/error state rather than crashing the sheet.

flatCases.title: Backgrounded tab suspends the realtime socket; missed events recovered only on resume
flatCases.preconditions: Web queue open; another client will insert/update/delete rows while this tab is backgrounded.
steps: Switch to another browser tab for a while; have another client modify the queue (insert, push-to-history, delete).
Do NOT interact; then refocus the tab.
flatCases.expected: While backgrounded no events are applied (socket suspended, no replay). On refocus, AppLifecycleState.resumed triggers refresh()+resync() and the queue/badge catch up. Verify nothing is silently lost after resume.

flatCases.title: Shell merge preserves per-id checked/status across realtime rebuilds
flatCases.preconditions: Queue with rows; a realtime event causes onEntriesChanged to fire.
steps: Observe a row's local UI state (e.g. status badge) before and after an unrelated realtime UPDATE rebuilds the list.
flatCases.expected: _onSupabaseEntriesChanged maps fresh rows by id and re-applies the existing checked/status from the prior list, so a rebuild does not reset those per-row UI fields.

flatCases.title: QueueBulkBar / multi-select is not wired: no bulk-confirm push exists
flatCases.preconditions: Queue with multiple rows.
steps: Look for any multi-select / select-all / bulk push affordance in the queue.
flatCases.expected: There is no live multi-select/bulk-confirm flow (QueueBulkBar and QueueEntry.checked exist but are not used by queue_screen.dart). 'checked' is only preserved across rebuilds; pushes are one row at a time.

flatCases.title: SECURITY: activate sends no company identity, bypassing the backend company-ownership guard
flatCases.preconditions: Understanding that each client uses a single per-tenant Supabase project under RLS (anon key).
steps: Capture the POST /api/sync/push-queue/activate request body during a push (network inspector / proxy).
Confirm the body contains only {job_id} with no company_id/company_guid/company_name.
flatCases.expected: The app sends only {job_id}, so the backend's hasCompanyIdentity branch is skipped and any pending row is flipped by id regardless of company. Safe ONLY under correct single-tenant RLS; a misconfigured RLS policy or a multi-company project (cf. reorder 409 duplicate-company incident) would allow cross-company activation. Record the missing company fields.

flatCases.title: Activate 400 when job_id missing/blank (backend contract)
flatCases.preconditions: Ability to call POST /api/sync/push-queue/activate directly (the UI always supplies a rowId, so this is an API-contract check).
steps: Send POST /api/sync/push-queue/activate with x-api-key and an empty/missing job_id.
flatCases.expected: Backend returns 400 'job_id is required'. (UI cannot normally trigger this because _activate returns early when rowId is empty.)

flatCases.title: Activate rejects a wrong/absent API key (auth)
flatCases.preconditions: Ability to call the endpoint with a tampered x-api-key.
steps: Send POST /api/sync/push-queue/activate with an incorrect x-api-key and a valid job_id.
flatCases.expected: requireApiKey (timingSafeEqual vs API_KEY) rejects the request (401/403) before any push_queue lookup; no row is activated.

flatCases.title: Reopen an 'under edit' row restores in-progress items even after a reload wiped the local stash
flatCases.preconditions: A row tagged 'under edit' whose _savedEdits stash was lost (e.g. app/tab reloaded since tagging).
steps: Reload the app, open the 'under edit' row from the queue.
flatCases.expected: The sheet opens straight into edit mode (initialIsEditing) and _seedEditSession reseeds items from the persisted voucher_payload, so the items still show; if the in-session stash survived, those in-progress items take precedence.

flatCases.title: Editing is blocked on a non-pending (push_now/pushed) row with a clear message
flatCases.preconditions: A row at status push_now or pushed opened in the sheet.
steps: Open the row and tap Edit.
flatCases.expected: _toggleEdit guard fires: snackbar 'This voucher is already queued for push and can't be edited.'; the sheet stays in view mode and no edit session starts.

flatCases.title: Edit/Add blocked while stock items cache is still loading
flatCases.preconditions: Just signed in; StockItemsCache still paginating (~13k items).
steps: Open a pending row and tap Edit (or Add) before the stock cache finishes loading.
flatCases.expected: Snackbar 'Loading of stock items in process, please wait'; edit mode does not start until the cache is ready.

flatCases.title: History boundary: a just-pushed row with an omitted TOASTed payload is re-fetched (renders correctly, not 'Unknown')
flatCases.preconditions: A row flips to 'pushed' via an UPDATE that omits the unchanged voucher_payload column.
steps: Push a voucher to completion and open the History screen as it lands.
flatCases.expected: history_push_queue detects the empty voucher_payload and re-fetches the full row before rendering, so the History card shows the real party/amount (NOT 'Unknown'). Contrast with the live queue, which does not re-fetch (see the queue corruption case).

flatCases.title: Revert after a saved edit writes the original payload back; revert without a save does not touch the server
flatCases.preconditions: A pending row.
steps: Case A: Open, Edit, change+Save, then tap Revert.
Case B: Open, Edit, change (no Save), tap Revert.
flatCases.expected: Case A (didSave true): _persistEditsToSupabase writes the original payload with snackbar 'Reverted to original.' Case B (didSave false): no server write (avoids re-touching status which would briefly drop the row from the status-filtered queue); only the 'Reverted to original.' snackbar shows.

flatCases.title: Concurrent edit vs activate on the same row: edit save loses to a concurrent activation
flatCases.preconditions: Two clients on the same pending row.
steps: Client A enters Edit and changes items. Client B taps Push To Tally and confirms (flips to push_now).
Client A taps Save.
flatCases.expected: Client B's activation flips status to push_now first; Client A's save .eq(status,'pending') matches 0 rows -> 'Couldn't save — this voucher may already be queued for push.' The pushed payload is B's (pre-A-edit) version. Confirm A's edits are not silently lost without notice.

flatCases.title: Open pending voucher detail sheet from queue
flatCases.preconditions: Signed in; at least one push_queue row with status='pending' visible in the Queue tab.
steps: Open the Queue tab
Tap a pending voucher row to open the detail sheet
flatCases.expected: Sheet opens; status pill shows 'pending'; Edit, Add, Revert (hidden until editing) and 'Push To Tally' controls are visible; if a stored/fresh image exists an Image tab/pane appears, otherwise Summary only.

flatCases.title: Open pushed voucher from History is read-only
flatCases.preconditions: At least one row with status='pushed' visible in History.
steps: Open History
Tap a pushed voucher row
flatCases.expected: Sheet opens readOnly: Edit/Add/Revert/Push and per-row delete are hidden; a 'Push Details' block shows pushed date/time from pushed_at; voucher is view-only.

flatCases.title: Open failed voucher shows error reason
flatCases.preconditions: A push_queue row with status='failed' and a non-empty error_message.
steps: Open the failed row from Queue (status=failed) or History
Inspect the header Push Details block
flatCases.expected: Status pill shows 'failed' with failure styling; Push Details shows the Tally error_message and timestamp.

flatCases.title: Edit blocked when status is push_now
flatCases.preconditions: A push_queue row currently status='push_now' (desktop poller about to pick it up).
steps: Open the push_now row
Tap Edit
flatCases.expected: Edit is rejected with snackbar 'already queued for push and can't be edited'; sheet stays in view mode; no editable cells appear.

flatCases.title: Email-sourced row shows Summary only (no Image tab)
flatCases.preconditions: A push_queue row whose source_payload.fetched_from == 'email'.
steps: Open the email-sourced row
flatCases.expected: Only the Summary tab/pane renders; no Image tab on phone and no left image pane on web/desktop.

flatCases.title: Row with stored scan images shows Image + Summary
flatCases.preconditions: A push_queue row with source_payload.scan.pages > 0 (stored GCS images), not email-sourced.
steps: Open the row
Confirm tab/pane layout
flatCases.expected: Phone shows an Image/Summary tab switcher; web/desktop (>=900px) shows image pane + summary pane side-by-side.

flatCases.title: Reopen an under-edit row re-seeds edit session and overlays stash
flatCases.preconditions: A row previously closed mid-edit (edit_state=under-edit, in-memory _savedEdits stash present for this session).
steps: From Queue, reopen the row tagged 'under edit'
Observe items and edit state
flatCases.expected: Sheet reopens already in editing mode with the previously-stashed editable items overlaid (not the original values); user can continue editing.

flatCases.title: Enter edit mode on a pending row seeds editable copies
flatCases.preconditions: Pending row open; StockItemsCache loaded (not loading).
steps: Tap Edit
flatCases.expected: Sheet enters edit mode; item cells (qty/rate/disc/amount), party dropdown, invoice#, narration become editable; Revert button appears; originals captured for later revert.

flatCases.title: Edit blocked while StockItemsCache is loading
flatCases.preconditions: Sign in fresh so StockItemsCache.isLoading is true (large ~13k catalog still paginating).
steps: Immediately open a pending row before caches finish
Tap Edit
flatCases.expected: Edit rejected with snackbar 'Loading of stock items in process'; sheet stays view-only until cache finishes.

flatCases.title: Tapping Add auto-enters edit mode
flatCases.preconditions: Pending row open, caches loaded.
steps: Tap Add (without first tapping Edit)
flatCases.expected: Sheet enters edit mode automatically then opens the stock item picker; if edit is blocked (status!=pending or cache loading) the corresponding snackbar shows and the picker does not open.

flatCases.title: Purchase item missing discount_pct: derived discount keeps Disc/Amount/Charges consistent
flatCases.preconditions: Purchase voucher whose item has amount < qty*rate but no discount_pct field.
steps: Open the purchase row
Tap Edit
Read the derived Disc% cell for that item and the Charges block
flatCases.expected: Disc% shows (1 - amount/(qty*rate))*100 clamped to 0..100; the displayed amount and Charges subtotal/discount reconcile with the line.

flatCases.title: Change party for a SALE voucher uses customers cache
flatCases.preconditions: Sale pending row open in edit mode; CustomersCache loaded.
steps: Tap the party-name dropdown
Search and pick a different customer (Sundry Debtor)
flatCases.expected: Party field updates to chosen customer; on Save the largest-abs ledger line is renamed to the new party.

flatCases.title: Change party for a PURCHASE voucher uses vendors cache
flatCases.preconditions: Purchase pending row open in edit mode; VendorsCache loaded.
steps: Tap the party-name dropdown
Pick a different vendor (Sundry Creditor)
flatCases.expected: Party field updates to chosen vendor; vendor list, not customer list, is shown.

flatCases.title: Party picker blocked while customer/vendor cache loading
flatCases.preconditions: CustomersCache or VendorsCache still downloading.
steps: Enter edit mode quickly
Tap party dropdown before cache finishes
flatCases.expected: Picker does not open; snackbar 'customer/vendor list is still downloading' shown.

flatCases.title: Party rename targets largest-abs ledger (wrong-ledger risk on tax-heavy voucher)
flatCases.preconditions: A multi-ledger voucher where the inventory/GST-Sale subtotal exceeds the party (debtor/creditor) line in absolute value.
steps: Open the row, Edit, change the party
Save
Inspect voucher_payload.ledger_entries in push_queue (Supabase)
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: the renamed-to-new-party ledger must be the actual party line, not the GST/inventory line. If the largest-abs line is the inventory subtotal, the wrong ledger gets renamed and _editableTotal is assigned to it — the voucher would post against the wrong ledger/amount. Flag any mismatch.

flatCases.title: Party-changed flag stays sticky across multiple saves
flatCases.preconditions: Sale pending row in edit mode.
steps: Change the party
Save
Change one item
Save again
Attempt Push without changing all items
flatCases.expected: _partyNameWasChanged remains true after the first change; push remains blocked until every item differs from original, even across intermediate saves.

flatCases.title: Add item via party-aware sale history (voucher_items)
flatCases.preconditions: Sale row in edit mode; party has prior sale history in voucher_items.
steps: Tap Add
Observe the default picker list
flatCases.expected: Picker lists items from voucher_items joined vouchers!inner filtered by this party_name and voucher_type like %sale%, newest-first, deduped per stock_item_name keeping the latest rate; selecting one appends qty=1 with that rate.

flatCases.title: Add item for PURCHASE uses the catalog
flatCases.preconditions: Purchase row in edit mode.
steps: Tap Add
Observe picker source
flatCases.expected: Picker shows the StockItemsCache catalog (purchase uses catalog, not party history).

flatCases.title: 'All items' toggle forces the full catalog in sale picker
flatCases.preconditions: Sale row in edit mode; party-aware list shown.
steps: Open Add picker
Toggle 'All items'
flatCases.expected: List switches from party-aware history to the full StockItemsCache catalog.

flatCases.title: Party-aware query error silently falls back to catalog
flatCases.preconditions: Force a voucher_items query failure (e.g. revoke select via RLS in a test project, or network blip).
steps: Open Add on a sale row
Trigger the party-aware fetch failure
flatCases.expected: Picker silently falls back to StockItemsCache catalog (no crash, no error toast); a handled error may be reported to Sentry.

flatCases.title: Appended item rescales GST/tax ledgers and recomputes total
flatCases.preconditions: Sale row in edit mode with a matched GST Sale inventory ledger and CGST/SGST tax ledgers.
steps: Add a new item
Inspect the Charges block (GST Sale, CGST, SGST, Discount, Total)
flatCases.expected: GST Sale = sum of item amounts; tax ledgers = GST Sale * stored ratio; discount and total recomputed; Charges reconcile with the new item set.

flatCases.title: Re-picking a high-confidence/historical item shows a warning first
flatCases.preconditions: Item flagged Purchase_Matching (green Historical) or Matching score>=90.
steps: In edit mode tap the item name to re-pick
Choose a different stock item
flatCases.expected: A confirm warning dialog appears before the item is overwritten; only on confirm are name/rate/discount/unit rewritten and amount recomputed.

flatCases.title: Qty change recomputes amount = qty*rate*(1-disc%)
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode.
steps: Edit an item's Qty cell to a new value
flatCases.expected: Amount cell updates to qty*rate*(1-disc/100); Charges block recomputes.

flatCases.title: Rate change recomputes amount
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode.
steps: Edit an item's Rate cell
flatCases.expected: Amount = qty*rate*(1-disc/100) updates; Charges recompute.

flatCases.title: Disc change recomputes amount and discount total
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode.
steps: Edit an item's Disc% cell
flatCases.expected: Amount recomputes; Charges Discount = sum(qty*rate*disc%/100) updates.

flatCases.title: Direct Amount edit overrides recompute (no qty*rate recalc)
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode.
steps: Type a value directly into the Amount cell of an item
flatCases.expected: Amount is set verbatim (no qty*rate recompute for that field); Charges recompute from the new amount.

flatCases.title: amount>gross discount-clamp silently raises an untouched line on first edit
flatCases.preconditions: A line where amount > qty*rate (price uplift / negative discount), so derived disc clamps to 0.
steps: Open the row, Edit
Touch ANY cell on that line (e.g. change qty by +0 then back, or edit a different cell that triggers _recalcAmount)
Read the line amount
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: because disc was clamped to 0, _recalcAmount=qty*rate*(1-0) silently LOWERS/changes the taxable amount to gross, changing the pushed value of an otherwise-untouched uplift line. Flag the silent value change.

flatCases.title: Proportional tax ledgers stay fixed when inventory ledger unmatched
flatCases.preconditions: A voucher where the inventory/GST-Sale ledger name does not match so _taxRatios are not built (invLedger unmatched).
steps: Edit item amounts (change qty/rate)
Inspect CGST/SGST ledger amounts vs item totals in Charges and in the saved payload
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: CGST/SGST remain at original values while item amounts changed, so ledger_entries total no longer reconciles with the pushed item lines. Flag the imbalance.

flatCases.title: Delete an item line with confirmation
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode with >=2 items.
steps: Tap an item row trash icon
Confirm 'Are you sure you want to delete <name>?'
flatCases.expected: Line removed; Charges rescale (GST Sale, tax, discount, total recompute).

flatCases.title: Save persists edits only while status=pending (status-guarded)
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode, status=pending.
steps: Make an edit
Tap Save
Verify push_queue.voucher_payload in Supabase
flatCases.expected: push_queue.update sets voucher_payload (with all __-prefixed keys stripped) where id=row AND status='pending'; .select('id') returns the row; success state; __-keys are not persisted.

flatCases.title: Save returns empty when row already flipped to push_now
flatCases.preconditions: Two clients: client A editing; client B (or desktop) flips the row to push_now.
steps: On client A, after the flip, tap Save
flatCases.expected: Status-guarded update matches 0 rows; snackbar "Couldn't save — may already be queued for push"; no payload change in DB.

flatCases.title: Save Supabase error reports handled error and offers retry
flatCases.preconditions: Force a Supabase write failure (offline, or RLS deny in a test project).
steps: Edit, tap Save while the write will fail
flatCases.expected: reportHandledError('supabase.push_queue.update') fired to Sentry; a retry snackbar shown; sheet stays in edit mode so user can retry.

flatCases.title: Save writes to the correct payload shape
flatCases.preconditions: Rows of each shape: voucher_payload.items, tally_payload.voucher_payload.items, matched_items, items.
steps: For each shape, edit an item and Save
Inspect the persisted payload
flatCases.expected: Edits land in the same key the items were read from; ledger_entries rebuilt with party line=_editableTotal*sign and discount_total set.

flatCases.title: Unexpected payload shape: edits silently not pushed
flatCases.preconditions: A push_queue row whose item list lives under an unrecognized key.
steps: Edit an item, Save, then Push
Inspect what Tally receives
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: edits may be written to the wrong field and silently not reflected in the pushed voucher. Flag any case where saved edits do not reach the pushed payload.

flatCases.title: Revert after a Save restores original via status-guarded write
flatCases.preconditions: Row edited and Saved this session, still status=pending.
steps: Tap Revert
flatCases.expected: _persistEditsToSupabase(_originalPayload) runs (status-guarded), payload restored to original, edit mode exits, _everSaved reset; row stays in the status-filtered queue.

flatCases.title: Revert with no prior Save is UI-only (no DB touch)
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode with unsaved changes only.
steps: Make edits without Saving
Tap Revert
flatCases.expected: UI restores original and shows a snackbar; NO Supabase write occurs (so the status-filtered refresh doesn't briefly drop the row).

flatCases.title: Push happy path: confirm, activate 2xx, await realtime, sale success modal
flatCases.preconditions: Sale pending row, not editing, backend API_KEY matches activateApiKey, desktop+Tally healthy.
steps: Tap Push To Tally
Confirm 'Are You Sure'
Wait for the realtime result
flatCases.expected: voucher_payload written (narration='Replara AI'), POST /api/sync/push-queue/activate {job_id} returns 2xx, spinner stays, status flips to push_now then pushed via vd_status_{rowId}; sheet pops; sale success dialog shown after sheet closes; onPushed triggers queue re-fetch.

flatCases.title: Pushing while still editing forces Save-first dialog
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode with unsaved edits.
steps: Tap Push To Tally while still editing
flatCases.expected: _SaveBeforePushDialog ('Kindly Save the invoice before pushing') shown; OK just dismisses; no save and no activate happen from the dialog.

flatCases.title: Push blocked: party changed but not all items changed
flatCases.preconditions: Row where party was changed but at least one item still equals original.
steps: Exit edit (Save), tap Push To Tally (or press Enter on Total)
flatCases.expected: Push blocked with snackbar 'Party Name is Changed!! Change all the items'; button renders disabled; _activate not called.

flatCases.title: Party-change guard is client-only and does NOT block Save/activate-by-other-means
flatCases.preconditions: Row with party changed, not all items changed.
steps: Save the edited payload (allowed)
Activate the row via another path (e.g. another client's Push, or backend activate directly)
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: the guard only gates this sheet's Push button; the edited payload can still be saved and later activated, pushing a party-mismatched voucher. Flag the bypass.

flatCases.title: Narration is force-overwritten to 'Replara AI' discarding user narration
flatCases.preconditions: Row in edit mode.
steps: Type a custom narration, Save (it persists), then Push
Inspect pushed voucher_payload.narration
flatCases.expected: narration is unconditionally set to 'Replara AI' at push, discarding the user-typed narration that was saved moments earlier; irreversible at push time. Confirm this is intended behavior; flag the data loss.

flatCases.title: Activate pre-push write has NO status guard (race overwrites mid-push payload)
flatCases.preconditions: Two actors: this sheet about to push; desktop has already flipped the row to push_now/pushed.
steps: Trigger Push on the sheet at the moment the desktop is mid-pushing the same row
Inspect the row after the activate POST returns 409
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: _activate's update {voucher_payload, narration='Replara AI'} uses .eq('id') ONLY (no status guard) and is NOT rolled back when the POST returns 409; the row can be left with a mutated payload + forced narration that no longer matches its status. Flag the unrolled-back write.

flatCases.title: Activate returns 401 (api-key mismatch) shows only generic failure
flatCases.preconditions: Backend process.env.API_KEY does NOT equal the app's Config.activateApiKey (publishable key).
steps: Tap Push, confirm
Observe result
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: Push fails with generic snackbar 'Failed (401): ...'; the preceding voucher_payload+narration write is already committed and not rolled back; reportFailure fired. Every push is broken until the env keys match. Flag the coupling.

flatCases.title: Activate returns 404 job not found
flatCases.preconditions: Row deleted server-side between open and push (job_id no longer exists).
steps: Tap Push, confirm
flatCases.expected: Snackbar 'Failed (404): Push queue job not found'; _isSubmitting cleared; reportFailure fired.

flatCases.title: Activate returns 409 must be pending
flatCases.preconditions: Row already non-pending server-side when activate runs.
steps: Tap Push, confirm
flatCases.expected: Snackbar shows 'Failed (409): ... must be pending before activation' (or 'could not be activated'); spinner clears; payload write not rolled back (see race case).

flatCases.title: Activate returns 500
flatCases.preconditions: Backend Supabase lookup/activation failure (simulate 500).
steps: Tap Push, confirm
flatCases.expected: Snackbar 'Failed (500): ...'; reportFailure fired; sheet stays open, _isSubmitting cleared.

flatCases.title: Activate network down / timeout
flatCases.preconditions: Device offline or backend unreachable.
steps: Tap Push, confirm
flatCases.expected: Catch branch: snackbar 'Error: <exception>'; reportFailure fired; _isSubmitting cleared; the preceding voucher_payload+narration write is NOT rolled back (on retry/desktop pickup the row carries forced narration).

flatCases.title: Race: terminal status arrives before activate POST returns
flatCases.preconditions: Fast desktop that pushes and flips the row to pushed before the activate HTTP response lands.
steps: Tap Push; ensure the realtime pushed update arrives during the in-flight POST
flatCases.expected: On 2xx, since _status is already pushed/failed, _handlePushResult resolves immediately; _awaitingPushResult guard prevents the realtime callback from double-firing the result modal.

flatCases.title: Partial Tally push (created>=1 AND errors>=1) reported as green success
flatCases.preconditions: Engineer a tally_response with created>=1 and errors>=1 on the pushed row.
steps: Push; let the realtime row carry created>=1 and errors>=1
Observe the result modal (sale)
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: success=(created>=1) wins, so a green success modal is shown masking partially-failed line items. Flag that partial failures are hidden from the user.

flatCases.title: Push fails at Tally: realtime status=failed shows fail dialog (sale)
flatCases.preconditions: Sale row; Tally rejects the voucher (created=0, errors>=1 or status=failed).
steps: Push; wait for the realtime terminal update
flatCases.expected: _handlePushResult classifies failure; sale fail dialog shown after sheet closes; error_message surfaced; status pill reflects 'failed'.

flatCases.title: Purchase push shows no success/fail modal (sale-only)
flatCases.preconditions: Purchase row pushed successfully.
steps: Push a purchase voucher; wait for terminal result
flatCases.expected: Sheet pops and queue re-fetches but no sale-style success/fail dialog appears (modal is sale-only).

flatCases.title: Realtime channel unsubscribed on sheet dispose
flatCases.preconditions: Open a row (subscribes vd_status_{rowId}).
steps: Open then close the sheet repeatedly
Monitor Supabase realtime channels / no leaked subscriptions
flatCases.expected: Each open subscribes one vd_status_{rowId} channel; dispose() unsubscribes it; no accumulation of stale channels across opens.

flatCases.title: Delete voucher removes row and pops sheet
flatCases.preconditions: Pending row open with onDiscard provided and __row_id present.
steps: Tap Delete
Confirm 'Are you sure You want to delete this Invoice'
flatCases.expected: onDiscard removes the row locally, sheet pops immediately, then push_queue.delete().eq('id') runs; 'Deleted.' snackbar; realtime DELETE syncs other clients.

flatCases.title: Delete failure leaves DB row (reappears on refresh)
flatCases.preconditions: Force the delete to throw (offline / RLS deny).
steps: Tap Delete, confirm (sheet pops before awaiting)
Pull-to-refresh or wait for realtime
flatCases.expected: DEFECT WATCH: sheet popped and row dropped locally before the awaited delete; on failure reportHandledError('supabase.push_queue.delete') + "Couldn't delete" snackbar, and the row reappears on next refresh (no compensating re-insert). Flag the optimistic-delete inconsistency.

flatCases.title: Delete a seed/fresh-scan row with no __row_id (local only)
flatCases.preconditions: A row constructed without __row_id (fresh scan / seed).
steps: Open it, tap Delete, confirm
flatCases.expected: onDiscard drops it locally and the sheet pops; no Supabase delete is attempted (rowId empty -> early return).

flatCases.title: View stored invoice pages streamed from GCS

steps: Open the Image tab/pane
Scroll through pages 0..N-1

flatCases.title: Image fetch 404 when storage disabled

flatCases.title: Image fetch 401 unauthorized (expired/invalid Firebase token)
flatCases.preconditions: Firebase token expired/invalid when image is requested.

flatCases.expected: Backend returns 401; image tile shows error; app does not silently render a stale/other-tenant image.

flatCases.title: Fresh-scan image renders from in-memory bytes (no network)

steps: Open the freshly-scanned voucher's Image view

flatCases.title: Close mid-edit stashes edits, marks under-edit, bumps created_at

steps: Close the sheet while still editing (back/swipe down)
Observe the queue row

flatCases.title: Close after Save marks edited and floats row to top
flatCases.preconditions: Row edited and Saved, then closed.
steps: Edit, Save, close the sheet
Observe ordering and the row tag

Cause an UPDATE echo lacking edit_state
Observe client A's row tag
flatCases.expected: Local _editMarkers overlay keeps the prior edit_state value; the row's edit badge does not flicker off; onRefresh later reconciles from PostgREST.

flatCases.title: Two clients open the same pending row; one pushes

Observe the phone's open sheet

steps: Begin editing on phone
Let desktop flip status to push_now
Tap Save on phone
flatCases.expected: Status-guarded Save matches 0 rows -> "Couldn't save — may already be queued for push"; phone edits are not persisted over the in-flight row.

flatCases.title: Delete on one client syncs via realtime DELETE to the other

steps: Delete the row on client A

flatCases.title: Web/desktop two-pane image+summary at >=900px

steps: Open the voucher sheet
Observe layout

steps: Enter edit mode on web (wide)

flatCases.title: Enter-to-move chain advances through fields (hardware keyboard)

steps: Focus Invoice #
Press Enter repeatedly

flatCases.title: Enter on Total field submits the push
flatCases.preconditions: Web/desktop, row not in edit mode (or after save), physical keyboard.
steps: Tab/Enter to the Total field
Press Enter
flatCases.expected: _submitFromTotal runs: if party-changed-guard passes, the push confirm dialog opens; if blocked, the 'change all the items' snackbar shows; no push when still editing (Save-first dialog).

flatCases.title: Down-arrow on an item name opens the stock picker (hardware keyboard)
flatCases.preconditions: Web/desktop, row in edit mode, focus on an item name.
steps: Press Down arrow on a focused item name
flatCases.expected: The stock-item picker opens for re-pick; arrow keys navigate the list.

flatCases.title: Pinned items column header only on wide; inline+shared-scroll on phone
flatCases.preconditions: Open an editable voucher with many items on web vs phone.

On phone, scroll the items table horizontally

flatCases.title: Summary capped/centered on wide (maxWidth 1080 web / 800)
flatCases.preconditions: Very wide browser window.
steps: Open a voucher with no image (Summary only) and observe width
flatCases.expected: Summary content is capped and centered (max ~1080 on web / 800 otherwise); it does not stretch full-bleed across an ultra-wide window.

flatCases.title: Desktop breakpoint resize toggles bottom-nav <-> side-rail and panes
flatCases.preconditions: Browser; a voucher sheet open with an image.
steps: Resize the window across the 900px breakpoint while the sheet is open
flatCases.expected: Crossing 900px switches between tabbed (single pane) and two-pane layouts (and bottom-nav<->side-rail at app level) without losing the open sheet's state.

flatCases.title: Web has no on-disk image cache but still renders images
flatCases.preconditions: Web build (no path_provider).
steps: Open a voucher image, close, reopen
Check network calls
flatCases.expected: Images render in-memory (Image.memory / fetched bytes); on web there is no on-disk cache so a fresh open refetches from GCS, but rendering still works and no file-share/save options appear.

flatCases.title: ML Kit document scanner is Android-only (entry to this domain)
flatCases.preconditions: Web/iOS build vs Android.
steps: On web/iOS attempt to scan a document that would create a queue row
On Android perform the scan
flatCases.expected: Web/iOS show 'only available on Android'; only Android can scan to create push_queue rows that later open this sheet. Confirm web users can still open/edit/push existing queue rows.

flatCases.title: Stock picker dedup keeps the latest rate per item
flatCases.preconditions: A party with the same stock_item_name sold at different rates on different dates.
steps: Open Add on a sale row for that party
Find the duplicated item in the list
flatCases.expected: Only one entry per stock_item_name appears, carrying the rate from the most recent parent voucher date (sorted desc, deduped).

flatCases.title: Sale 'quantity' vs purchase 'qty' key handled on read and write
flatCases.preconditions: A sale row (uses 'quantity') and a purchase row (uses 'qty').
steps: Edit a qty cell on each, Save, inspect persisted item maps
flatCases.expected: Reads accept both keys; the qty onChanged writes whichever key already exists on the item; newly Added items always write 'quantity'. No duplicate/zeroed qty fields introduced.

flatCases.title: RLS prevents editing another tenant's push_queue row
flatCases.preconditions: Anon/publishable key with RLS; a row id belonging to a different tenant project.
steps: Attempt a Save/activate write targeting a foreign row id (via crafted request)
flatCases.expected: RLS rejects the write (0 rows / error); no cross-tenant payload mutation occurs; handled error reported.

flatCases.title: Fresh-scan pendingPayload path is currently unwired (regression guard)
flatCases.preconditions: Code review / build inspection.
steps: Confirm both live constructions (queue_screen, history_screen) pass payload:, not pendingPayload:
Exercise the normal flows
flatCases.expected: No call site passes pendingPayload, so the _onPendingResolved / _DuplicatePurchaseDialog branch never triggers in the app; if a future change wires it, the duplicate-purchase dialog and processing state must be re-tested.

flatCases.title: Reorder/company-name 409 risk does not corrupt voucher push
flatCases.preconditions: Duplicate 'K V ENTERPRISES' company rows exist (known reorder 409 risk).
steps: Push a voucher while the company has duplicate rows
Confirm the push path omits company identity
flatCases.expected: The activate POST sends only {job_id} (no company_id/guid/name), so the optional company match is skipped and the duplicate-company 409 does NOT affect Push-to-Tally; only the reorder report is at risk.

flatCases.title: Double-tap Push is debounced by _isSubmitting
flatCases.preconditions: Pending row ready to push.
steps: Tap Push To Tally twice rapidly (or press Enter on Total twice)
flatCases.expected: _isSubmitting/_submitFromTotal early-return prevents a second activate; only one voucher_payload write + one POST is issued.

flatCases.title: History loads pushed vouchers grouped by month, newest first
flatCases.preconditions: Signed in on testing project (yynuu). At least 3 push_queue rows with status='pushed' across 2 different months, each with a valid voucher_payload (party_name, voucher_type, ledger_entries).
steps: Open the app and navigate to the History tab.
Observe the list while it loads.
Note the month section headers and the order of cards within each section.
flatCases.expected: List renders cards grouped under full-month headers (e.g. 'June 2026'). Within and across groups, cards are sorted by pushed_at descending (newest at top). Each card shows party name, date label (e.g. '28 Jun'), and signed amount.

flatCases.title: Empty history shows 'No records'
flatCases.preconditions: Signed-in account/project whose RLS-visible push_queue has zero rows with status='pushed'.
steps: Open the History tab.
Wait for load to complete.
flatCases.expected: Centered muted text 'No records' is displayed; no cards, no error, no infinite spinner.

flatCases.title: Initial history select failure is swallowed -> empty list, no error UI
flatCases.preconditions: Ability to force the initial Supabase select to fail (disable network before opening History, or temporarily break RLS/anon key).
steps: Disable the device/browser network (airplane mode / offline).
Open the History tab fresh (cold).
Observe the screen.
flatCases.expected: Screen shows 'No records' with NO error banner/toast/dialog (catch{} swallows the error). Restoring network and re-entering the screen reloads the data. Document that a transient backend/RLS hiccup is indistinguishable from genuinely-empty history.

flatCases.title: Re-entering History re-fetches the list (foreground resync)
flatCases.preconditions: History previously loaded with N rows; ability to push/insert one more pushed row while on another tab.
steps: Open History, note the rows.
Navigate away to another tab.
Insert/push one more row to status='pushed' (e.g. via Supabase console on yynuu).
Return to the History tab.
flatCases.expected: On re-entry initState re-runs _fetchAndSubscribe and the new pushed row appears (also covered live by realtime). No duplicate cards for existing rows.

flatCases.title: Rows with empty id are skipped during initial load
flatCases.preconditions: Craft a push_queue row with status='pushed' but an empty/null id (if achievable via direct DB insert).
steps: Insert a pushed row with empty id.
Open History.
flatCases.expected: The empty-id row is not added to the list (load loop skips ids that stringify to ''). No crash. Effectively unreachable from the UI.

flatCases.title: Filter tabs All / Sale / Purchase partition the list client-side
flatCases.preconditions: History contains at least one row with voucher_type containing 'SALE' and one purchase row.
steps: Open History (tab 'All' selected).
Tap 'Sale' and review the list.
Tap 'Purchase' and review the list.
Tap 'All' again.
flatCases.expected: 'All' shows every pushed row. 'Sale' shows only rows whose voucher_type (uppercased) contains 'SALE'. 'Purchase' shows the rest. Switching tabs does not re-query the backend (purely client-side filter of in-memory rows).

flatCases.title: voucher_type classification: 'SALE' -> Sale, blank/missing -> Purchase
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed rows: (a) voucher_type='Sales', (b) voucher_type missing/blank, (c) voucher_type='Purchase'.
steps: Open History.
Locate each of the three rows.
Check which filter tab each appears under and the +/- sign / color of the amount.
flatCases.expected: Row (a) classified Sale (appears under 'Sale'). Rows (b) and (c) classified Purchase (appear under 'Purchase'). Confirm that a blank voucher_type silently buckets as Purchase and flips receivable vs payable presentation — flag as a data-integrity risk.

flatCases.title: Typo'd voucher_type silently classifies as Purchase
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row with voucher_type='Slae' (typo) or 'Tax Invoice' (no 'SALE' substring) but is actually a sale.
steps: Open History and find the row.
Observe which tab it appears under and the sign of the amount.
flatCases.expected: Row is bucketed as Purchase (since uppercased type lacks 'SALE'), misrepresenting a sale. No warning shown. Document as misclassification edge.

flatCases.title: Date label and month grouping prefer pushed_at
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row with pushed_at and created_at in DIFFERENT months.
steps: Open History.
Find the row and read its date label and the month-section header it sits under.
flatCases.expected: Both the card date label and the month group are derived from pushed_at (converted to local time), not created_at.

flatCases.title: pushed_at null falls back to created_at for date/grouping
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row with pushed_at=null and a valid created_at.
steps: Open History and find the row.
Verify its date label and month grouping.
flatCases.expected: Date label and month group come from created_at. Sort key is created_at epoch ms.

flatCases.title: Both timestamps null/garbage -> bucketed under current month, sorted to top
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row with pushed_at=null and created_at=null or unparseable.
steps: Open History and locate the row.
flatCases.expected: Row is grouped under the CURRENT month and, because its sortKey is DateTime.now(), sorts to the very top of the list. No crash. Flag the misleading placement.

flatCases.title: Card amount = abs(first ledger_entries.amount)
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed sale row whose ledger_entries.first is the party/total ledger with a negative amount (e.g. -11800).
steps: Open History and locate the row.
Read the displayed amount.
flatCases.expected: Card shows the absolute value (11800) of the FIRST ledger entry. Verify this equals the intended voucher total for a normal single-party voucher.

flatCases.title: Multi-ledger tax-split voucher can show a wrong/partial amount
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row where ledger_entries[0] is a GST/rounding ledger (e.g. 900) and the true total is on a later entry (e.g. 5900).
steps: Open History and find the row.
Compare the displayed amount with the actual invoice total.
flatCases.expected: Card displays abs(ledger_entries[0].amount) = 900, NOT the 5900 total — a money-display integrity defect when the party/total ledger is not first. Display-only (no write). Record as confirmed risk.

flatCases.title: Empty ledger_entries renders amount 0.00
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row with ledger_entries=[] or missing.
steps: Open History and find the row.
flatCases.expected: Card shows 0.00 (or +0.00 / -0.00 per type) without crashing.

flatCases.title: Tap a history card opens a read-only voucher detail sheet
flatCases.preconditions: History list with at least one tappable card (non-empty rowId, row present in map).
steps: Open History.
Tap a card.
Inspect the bottom sheet that opens.
flatCases.expected: VoucherDetailSheet opens with readOnly=true: shows Summary (party/items/charges) and, if applicable, an Image tab. There are NO edit/push/save controls (read-only). Synthetic keys __row_id/__status/__pushed_at/__error_message/__source_payload are populated (status defaults 'pushed').

flatCases.title: Card with empty rowId is non-tappable
flatCases.preconditions: A HistoryEntry whose rowId is empty (rare; load loop normally skips empty ids).
steps: Attempt to tap such a card if present.
flatCases.expected: onTap is null — tapping does nothing, no sheet opens, no crash.

flatCases.title: Row removed from map between list render and tap -> sheet does not open
flatCases.preconditions: Two clients. Card visible on client A.
steps: On client A keep History open with a card visible.
On client B (or Supabase console) flip that row's status away from 'pushed' (or delete it) so a realtime UPDATE/DELETE removes it from A's map.
Immediately tap the (now stale) card on client A.
flatCases.expected: _openSheet looks up the row, finds null, and early-returns — no sheet, no crash. The card is also removed from the list on the next frame.

flatCases.title: Single-page scanned invoice image loads via backend/GCS
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row from a real camera/OCR scan with source_payload.scan.pages=1 and the page-0.jpg present in GCS; INVOICE_BUCKET configured on backend.
steps: Open History, tap the row.
On mobile tap the 'Image' tab; on wide web observe the left image pane.
Wait for the page to load.
flatCases.expected: A spinner shows briefly, then the invoice page renders (Image.memory, fit width). No 'Page X of N' header for a single page. The bytes came from GET /api/sync/push-queue/<rowId>/image/0.

flatCases.title: Multi-page invoice shows 'Page X of N', lazy-loads, caches on scroll-back
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row with source_payload.scan.pages=3 and all 3 page JPEGs present in GCS.
steps: Open the row's Image view.
Scroll down through pages 1->2->3, watching each load.
Scroll back up to page 1.
flatCases.expected: Each page lazily fetched once (separate GET per page index 0..2) with its own spinner; headers read 'Page 1 of 3', 'Page 2 of 3', 'Page 3 of 3'. Scrolling back up does NOT re-download (in-memory _pageFutures cache). Network trace shows exactly 3 image GETs.

flatCases.title: Image tab shown only when not email AND scan.pages > 0
flatCases.preconditions: Two pushed rows: one with scan.pages>0 (scanned), one with scan.pages=0.
steps: Open each row's detail sheet.
Check whether an Image tab/pane is offered.
flatCases.expected: Scanned row (pages>0) offers Image + Summary. pages=0 row offers Summary only (no Image tab, no image GET fired). In History imageBytes is always null, so the Image tab depends purely on scan.pages>0.

flatCases.title: Storage disabled (INVOICE_BUCKET unset) -> every page 404 -> 'Couldn't load this page.'
flatCases.preconditions: Backend running with invoiceStorageEnabled=false (INVOICE_BUCKET unset) but a row whose scan.pages>0.
steps: Open the row's Image view.
Wait for each page request to resolve.
flatCases.expected: Backend returns 404 {error:'Invoice image storage is not configured'} for every page. Each page slot shows the 120px tile 'Couldn't load this page.'. App reports the non-200 to Sentry (status only). No crash.

flatCases.title: Image object missing for page -> 404 'Image not found' -> error tile
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row with scan.pages=2 but only page-0.jpg stored in GCS (page-1 missing).
steps: Open the row's Image view and scroll to page 2.
flatCases.expected: Page 1 renders; Page 2 GET returns 404 (invoicePageExists false) and shows 'Couldn't load this page.' Other pages remain unaffected (independent futures).

flatCases.title: Invalid id/page -> backend 400 -> error tile
flatCases.preconditions: Ability to force a malformed page index (e.g. negative) or empty id through the endpoint (manual/Postman) — UI normally sends valid 0..N-1.
steps: Issue GET /api/sync/push-queue/<id>/image/-1 (or empty id) with valid auth.
Observe the response.
In-app, if reachable, observe the error tile.
flatCases.expected: Backend returns 400 {error:'Invalid id or page'}. In-app FutureBuilder shows 'Couldn't load this page.' Tester confirms the UI never generates such a request itself.

flatCases.title: GCS read failure -> backend 500 -> error tile
flatCases.preconditions: Force a GCS read-stream/exists() error (e.g. revoke bucket permission or corrupt object) for a row with scan.pages>0.
steps: Open the row's Image view and wait.
flatCases.expected: Backend returns 500 ('Image read failed' or thrown message). App's getBytes throws 'Request failed: 500'; tile shows 'Couldn't load this page.'; non-200 reported to Sentry. No app crash.

flatCases.title: Expired/invalid Firebase token still authorizes image GET via x-api-key
flatCases.preconditions: A way to make getIdToken() return a stale/invalid token while Config.mrpApiKey is valid; row with scan.pages>0.
steps: Force the Firebase token to be invalid/expired.
Open the row's Image view.
flatCases.expected: requireApiKey accepts the always-sent x-api-key (timingSafeEqual vs API_KEY) even though the Bearer token is bad, so the page still loads (no 401). Confirms ApiClient.getBytes sends BOTH x-api-key and Authorization, and strips Content-Type for binary GET.

flatCases.title: 401 on image GET surfaces as error tile when neither credential is valid
flatCases.preconditions: Force both a bad Firebase token AND a wrong x-api-key (e.g. misconfigured Config.mrpApiKey) for a scanned row.
steps: Open the row's Image view.
flatCases.expected: Backend returns 401; getBytes throws Exception('Unauthorized'); tile shows 'Couldn't load this page.'; reported to Sentry. Note the rest of the app (Supabase anon reads) is unaffected.

flatCases.title: Network down during image fetch -> spinner then error tile
flatCases.preconditions: Scanned row with scan.pages>0; ability to drop network after opening the sheet.
steps: Open the row's Image view.
Immediately disable network so the GET cannot complete.
Wait.
flatCases.expected: Page slot shows the spinner then transitions to 'Couldn't load this page.' (getBytes throws). Summary tab (already-loaded payload) remains viewable.

flatCases.title: Partial GCS upload: scan.pages overcounts -> some pages 404 while others render
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row where source_payload.scan.pages = number REQUESTED (e.g. 3) but only 2 pages actually uploaded to GCS (uploadInvoicePages best-effort failure).
steps: Open the row's Image view and scroll through all advertised pages.
flatCases.expected: Stored pages render; the missing page(s) show 'Couldn't load this page.' The header still advertises N pages (overcount). Document that scan.pages is the count requested, not persisted — users may think a stored image is corrupt when only some pages failed.

flatCases.title: Skew: scan.pages>0 recorded but bucket later unset -> Image tab shows, all pages 404
flatCases.preconditions: Row enqueued while storage enabled (scan.pages=2), then backend redeployed with INVOICE_BUCKET unset.
steps: Open the row's detail sheet.
Confirm the Image tab is offered, then open it.
flatCases.expected: Because pages>0, the Image tab is still shown, but every page GET returns 404 'Invoice image storage is not configured' -> all tiles show 'Couldn't load this page.' The app cannot distinguish this from a missing image.

flatCases.title: A failed page future is cached and does NOT auto-retry until the sheet reopens
flatCases.preconditions: Scanned row; ability to make page-0 fail once (network blip) then restore.
steps: Open the Image view so page 0 errors -> 'Couldn't load this page.'
Restore network.
Scroll the page in/out of view within the SAME open sheet.
Close the sheet and reopen it from the same card.
flatCases.expected: Within the same sheet instance the failed future is cached, so the error tile persists (no auto-retry). Closing and reopening the sheet creates a new _StoredInvoiceImages instance and re-downloads — page now loads. Confirms in-memory-per-instance caching.

flatCases.title: GCS stream error mid-pipe -> that page's tile errors, others unaffected
flatCases.preconditions: Induce a mid-stream GCS read error (truncate object / kill connection) for one page of a multi-page row after headers sent.
steps: Open the multi-page Image view and load the affected page.
flatCases.expected: Backend logs and res.destroy()s the truncated response; getBytes throws -> that page shows 'Couldn't load this page.'; other pages (independent futures) still render correctly.

flatCases.title: Email-sourced row (fetched_from='email') is Summary-only, no image call
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row with source_payload.fetched_from='email' (scan.pages may be 0 or absent).
steps: Open the row's detail sheet.
Check the available tabs and watch the network for any image GET.
flatCases.expected: _availableModes = [Summary] only; no Image tab; zero requests to the image endpoint. Summary renders party/items/charges from voucher_payload.

flatCases.title: Digital-PDF / pre-feature row (scan.pages=0) is Summary-only
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed row that is non-scanned/native-PDF or pre-storage-feature with source_payload.scan.pages absent or 0.
steps: Open the detail sheet and check tabs.
flatCases.expected: Summary-only, no Image tab, no image GET.

flatCases.title: Realtime INSERT of a pushed row appears in History live
flatCases.preconditions: History open on client A. Ability to INSERT a push_queue row with status='pushed' (console, or another client completing a push).
steps: Keep History open on client A.
INSERT a new pushed row (or push a voucher to completion on client B).
Observe client A without manual refresh.
flatCases.expected: history_push_queue INSERT handler ingests the row (status=='pushed') and it appears in A's list, grouped/sorted correctly, with no manual refresh.

flatCases.title: Realtime INSERT with non-pushed status is ignored by History
flatCases.preconditions: History open. Ability to INSERT a push_queue row with status='pending' or 'push_now'.
steps: INSERT a row with status='pending'.
Observe History.
flatCases.expected: Row does NOT appear in History (insert handler returns unless status=='pushed').

flatCases.title: Realtime UPDATE to 'pushed' adds row; UPDATE away from 'pushed' removes it
flatCases.preconditions: History open on client A; a push_queue row currently visible/pushed and another currently pending.
steps: Flip the pending row's status -> 'pushed' (e.g. complete a push elsewhere).
Then flip a currently-shown pushed row's status -> 'failed' (or back to pending).
Observe client A after each change.
flatCases.expected: First change ingests the row into History (appears). Second change removes the row from History (no longer 'pushed') silently, with no tombstone/animation.

flatCases.title: Realtime DELETE removes the card from History
flatCases.preconditions: History open with a visible pushed card; ability to DELETE that push_queue row.
steps: DELETE the row from push_queue.
Observe client A.
flatCases.expected: The card disappears from History (delete handler removes oldRecord.id). No crash.

flatCases.title: TOAST-omitted voucher_payload on realtime UPDATE triggers PostgREST re-fetch
flatCases.preconditions: History open. A row that flips to status='pushed' via UPDATE while its large voucher_payload column is unchanged (so Realtime omits it).
steps: Cause a status-only UPDATE -> 'pushed' on a row with an unchanged voucher_payload (e.g. set pushed_at/status without touching payload).
Observe the new card's party name and amount.
flatCases.expected: _ingestPushedRow detects the empty parsed payload and re-fetches the full row by id from PostgREST, so the card shows the correct party/amount (NOT 'Unknown'/0).

flatCases.title: TOAST re-fetch failure leaves a payload-less 'Unknown' / +0.00 card with no retry
flatCases.preconditions: Same TOAST-omission scenario, but force the PostgREST re-fetch to fail (network drop right after the realtime event, or RLS blip).
steps: Trigger a status-only UPDATE -> 'pushed' while voucher_payload is omitted.
Make the subsequent re-fetch fail.
Observe the card.
flatCases.expected: catch{} swallows the re-fetch error and the payload-less row is shown: party 'Unknown', amount +0.00, type defaults to Purchase. There is NO automatic retry — re-entering the screen (which re-selects full rows) is the only recovery. Flag as a real-transaction-hiding risk.

flatCases.title: Duplicate realtime events for the same id do not duplicate the card
flatCases.preconditions: History open; ability to emit two INSERT/UPDATE events for the same pushed row id.
steps: Fire two realtime events for the same row id.
Count the cards for that id.
flatCases.expected: Exactly one card (rows keyed by id in a Map; later event overwrites). Idempotent.

flatCases.title: Phone scans+pushes a voucher while web History is open -> web updates live
flatCases.preconditions: Same tenant project. Web client signed in with History open. Android phone signed in, ready to scan an invoice. Parsing + push pipeline operational.
steps: On the phone, scan/submit an invoice (creates scan_jobs row, parsing inserts a push_queue row).
On the phone, push the resulting queue voucher to completion (status -> pushed).
Watch the web History screen the whole time without refreshing.
flatCases.expected: Web History does not show the row while it is pending/push_now (only 'pushed' qualifies); once the push completes, the pushed row appears at the top of web History via the history_push_queue realtime channel. Demonstrates cross-device realtime consistency.

flatCases.title: Read-only history sheet opens vd_status_<rowId> channel that stays idle (terminal)
flatCases.preconditions: History detail sheet opened for a pushed (terminal) row.
steps: Open a history card's detail sheet.
Leave it open briefly, then close it.
If possible, monitor the Supabase realtime connection for the channel.
flatCases.expected: The readOnly sheet subscribes to vd_status_<rowId> (shared sheet code) but since status is already 'pushed' (terminal) no status changes arrive — effectively idle. The channel is unsubscribed on sheet dispose (no leak).

flatCases.title: Two clients open the same row's image -> independent in-memory caches
flatCases.preconditions: Same pushed scanned row reachable from two clients.
steps: Open the row's Image view on client A (pages cache).
Open the same row's Image view on client B.
flatCases.expected: Each client fetches its own copies via the backend (no shared cache); both render correctly. Closing one does not affect the other.

flatCases.title: Web desktop (width >= 900): sheet capped at 90% width with two-pane image+summary
flatCases.preconditions: Web build, browser window width >= 900. A scanned pushed row (scan.pages>0).
steps: Maximize the browser (>=900px) and open History.
Tap a scanned row.
flatCases.expected: The modal sheet is constrained to ~90% of the screen width and shows the two-pane layout: image pane on the left, summary on the right (no Image/Summary toggle on wide screens). 900 matches the bottom-nav->side-rail breakpoint.

flatCases.title: Web narrow (width < 900): full-width sheet with Image/Summary toggle
flatCases.preconditions: Web build, browser window narrowed to < 900px. A scanned pushed row.
steps: Resize the browser to < 900px and open History.
Tap a scanned row.
Toggle between Image and Summary.
flatCases.expected: Sheet uses full width (double.infinity cap) and presents the Image/Summary tab switcher (single-pane). Toggling shows the GCS image vs the summary. Resizing across 900 flips the layout.

flatCases.title: Web 1.4x text scaling renders History without overflow
flatCases.preconditions: Web build (global 1.4x text scaling applied).
steps: Open History on web with several rows and long party names.
Inspect card text, month headers, filter tabs, and the detail summary.
flatCases.expected: Text is scaled 1.4x; party names/amounts/month headers wrap or ellipsize gracefully with no clipping/overflow exceptions; layout remains usable.

flatCases.title: Web has no on-disk image cache (no path_provider) but images still load from GCS
flatCases.preconditions: Web build; scanned pushed row.
steps: Open the row's Image view on web and let it load.
Close and reopen the same sheet.
flatCases.expected: Image loads correctly from the backend/GCS (path_provider/disk cache is irrelevant for History since it is GCS-only). Reopening re-downloads (no persistent cache on web). Functionally identical to mobile.

flatCases.title: Web refresh restores session and image GET re-auth still works
flatCases.preconditions: Web build, signed in, History open with a scanned row.
steps: Hard-refresh the browser tab.
Wait for session restore (authStateChanges), navigate to History.
Open the scanned row's Image view.
flatCases.expected: Session is restored via authStateChanges; a fresh Firebase token is obtained for getBytes, so image GETs authorize and pages render. No re-login required, no 401 cascade.

flatCases.title: Mobile: orphaned InvoiceImageStore is unused -> History images are always GCS, nothing on disk
flatCases.preconditions: Android build. A freshly scanned invoice just pushed to 'pushed' but GCS upload still propagating, vs after propagation.
steps: On Android, scan and push an invoice.
Immediately open History and the just-pushed row's Image view (before GCS upload/propagation completes).
Then wait and reopen after upload completes.
Optionally inspect app documents directory for any cached .jpg for the rowId.
flatCases.expected: History never receives in-memory fresh-scan imageBytes, so the Image view depends entirely on GCS via the backend: it shows spinner/'Couldn't load this page.' until the parsing service has stored the pages, then renders. No .jpg is written to disk (InvoiceImageStore is dead code, never imported/called). Confirms the documented on-disk cache does NOT exist.

flatCases.title: Mobile bottom-nav + full-width sheet layout for History
flatCases.preconditions: Android phone (width < 900).
steps: Open History on the phone and open a scanned row.
Observe navigation chrome and sheet width.
flatCases.expected: Bottom navigation bar is used (not side-rail); the detail sheet is full width with the Image/Summary toggle (single pane). No two-pane layout.

flatCases.title: No company scoping: a single project with two companies mixes all pushed vouchers
flatCases.preconditions: A Supabase project whose push_queue contains pushed rows for TWO different companies and whose RLS does NOT segregate by company (or test user can see both).
steps: Sign in and open History.
Inspect the parties/vouchers listed.
flatCases.expected: History query is only .eq('status','pushed') with NO company_id/user filter, so it shows BOTH companies' pushed vouchers intermixed. Scoping relies ENTIRELY on RLS + per-tenant project. If RLS is mis-set, this is a cross-company data-exposure/integrity defect — verify RLS strictly limits visible rows to the signed-in tenant/company.

flatCases.title: RLS limits History rows to the authorized tenant (anon/publishable key)
flatCases.preconditions: Two tenant projects (yynuu testing vs another) OR two users with distinct RLS scope; pushed rows in each.
steps: Sign in as user/tenant A and note the History rows.
Sign in as user/tenant B and note the History rows.
flatCases.expected: Each session only sees rows its RLS policy permits; no rows from the other tenant/user leak. Confirms the app's reliance on RLS (it sends no scoping filter and uses the anon/publishable key) is sound for the tested policy.

flatCases.title: History detail sheet is strictly read-only (no edit/push affordances)
flatCases.preconditions: Any pushed row.
steps: Open a history card's detail sheet.
Inspect Summary for any editable fields, item add/remove, party change, or a Push/Save button.
flatCases.expected: readOnly=true: no editable inputs, no item/party mutation, no Push or Save action. The sheet cannot write voucher_payload or call activate. Closing the sheet leaves the row unchanged in push_queue.
integration_points: Main backend: activate (must NOT be called)

flatCases.title: voucher_payload accepted as Map or JSON string; unparseable string degrades gracefully
flatCases.preconditions: Three pushed rows: (a) voucher_payload as JSON object, (b) as a JSON STRING, (c) as an unparseable string ('not json').
steps: Open History.
Inspect each row's card and open its detail sheet.
flatCases.expected: (a) and (b) parse and render party/amount/items correctly. (c) yields {} -> card shows party 'Unknown', amount 0.00, type defaults Purchase; sheet opens without crashing.

flatCases.title: Status flips pushed->failed via realtime while list is open -> silent removal
flatCases.preconditions: History open with a visible pushed card; ability to UPDATE that row's status to 'failed'.
steps: Update the visible row's status from 'pushed' to 'failed'.
Observe the History list.
flatCases.expected: The card is silently removed (no longer status=='pushed') with no tombstone/animation/toast. It would reappear in the Queue (failed) but not in History.

flatCases.title: Large history list (thousands of pushed rows) loads and scrolls
flatCases.preconditions: Project/tenant with a large number of pushed rows (e.g. 2,000+).
steps: Open History.
Scroll through multiple month groups.
Switch filter tabs.
flatCases.expected: List loads in one select (no pagination) and renders/scrolls without freezing or OOM; month grouping and sorting remain correct. Note load time and memory as observations (single un-paginated fetch is a scalability consideration).

flatCases.title: Month group header shows full month name and year; multi-year separation
flatCases.preconditions: Pushed rows spanning the same month in two different years (e.g. June 2025 and June 2026).
steps: Open History and scroll through the groups.
flatCases.expected: Headers read full month + year (e.g. 'June 2025' and 'June 2026') as DISTINCT groups; cards are bucketed into the correct year group.

flatCases.title: Insights list renders all 7 seed categories on open
flatCases.preconditions: Signed in. App on the Report screen.
steps: Open the Report screen (bottom-nav/side-rail Report).
Confirm the 'Insights' tab is selected by default (tab index 0).
Observe the scrollable list.
flatCases.expected: Exactly 7 rows appear in order: act_now (🚨), hero_sku_health (🏆), dead_capital (💀), buying_mistakes (⚠️), wind_down (🪟), risk_watch (👀), full_portfolio_health (📊). Each shows /<key>, emoji and its description. No network request is fired until a row is tapped (verify via proxy/devtools: zero GETs on load).

flatCases.title: Chat tab shows static 'Coming Soon.....' with no backend call
flatCases.preconditions: Signed in. On the Report screen.
steps: Tap the 'Chat' tab (index 1).
Watch the AnimatedSwitcher transition.
Inspect network traffic.
flatCases.expected: A centered 'Coming Soon.....' text is shown. No API, Supabase, or realtime calls are made. Switching back to 'Insights' restores the list.

flatCases.title: Open report R1 (act_now) on WEB returns CSV and renders spreadsheet
flatCases.preconditions: Signed in on web. Backend reachable; API_KEY_CLIENT set; client Supabase has a single 'K V ENTERPRISES' company with last_synced_at populated and stock/voucher data.
steps: On web, tap the 'act_now' (🚨) report row.
Observe the spinner on the tapped row.
Wait for the bottom sheet.
flatCases.expected: A single GET /api/sync/reorder-levels/R1?company_name=K V ENTERPRISES&format=csv is sent (headers x-api-key=mrpApiKey, x-request-id present, Authorization Bearer if signed in, no Content-Type). Backend returns 200 text/csv. AppSpreadsheetSheet opens at 92% height with column headers, data rows, footer '/act_now.csv', and a live Σ over closing_stock_amount. No share button on web.

flatCases.title: Open all 7 reports (R1-R7) in sequence on web each returns its filtered view
flatCases.preconditions: Signed in on web; backend healthy; single synced 'K V ENTERPRISES'.
steps: Tap each of the 7 report rows one at a time, closing the sheet between each.
For each, note the URL reportId (R1..R7) and the footerMeta label.
Verify the rendered columns/rows differ per report key.
flatCases.expected: Each tap issues GET .../reorder-levels/R<n> with the same company_name/format query and returns 200. Each sheet shows that report's footerMeta (e.g. 'Live data · sorted by ₹ impact' for act_now) and the report-key-specific data. No tap reuses another report's payload.

flatCases.title: Mobile cache miss: first open fetches and writes <appDocs>/reports/<reportId>.csv
flatCases.preconditions: Android device, signed in, backend healthy. App data cleared so /reports/ has no cached CSV.
steps: Tap 'dead_capital' (R3) for the first time.
Wait for the sheet to render.
Inspect app documents directory /reports/ (via device file explorer or adb).
flatCases.expected: A GET .../reorder-levels/R3 is issued (cache miss path). On 200, the CSV is written to <appDocs>/reports/R3.csv. The sheet renders the data and a Share icon is present (mobile, reportId!=null).

flatCases.title: Mobile cache hit: re-tap serves disk snapshot with NO network call
flatCases.preconditions: Android. R3 already opened once so /reports/R3.csv exists.
steps: Start a network capture.
Tap 'dead_capital' (R3) again.
Observe the sheet and the capture.
flatCases.expected: No GET is sent. The sheet renders from the on-disk R3.csv (file.readAsString). Note the footer still says 'Live data ...' even though data is the frozen cached snapshot.

flatCases.title: Mobile share: share icon exports the cached CSV file
flatCases.preconditions: Android. A report (e.g. R7) opened so /reports/R7.csv exists. Sheet open.
steps: In the open spreadsheet sheet, tap the Share icon.
Choose a target app (e.g. Files/Gmail/WhatsApp).
flatCases.expected: The OS share sheet opens with one attachment named for the cached file, subject 'full_portfolio_health.csv'. Sharing delivers the actual CSV file. If the cache file were somehow missing, share is a no-op (guarded by file.exists()).

flatCases.title: Web has NO share button on the report sheet
flatCases.preconditions: Signed in on web. A report opened so the sheet is showing.
steps: Open any report (R1-R7) on web.
Inspect the spreadsheet sheet toolbar/footer for a share control.
flatCases.expected: No Share button is rendered (onShare=null when kIsWeb). All other controls (Close, search, Σ footer) work. No path_provider usage is attempted on web.

flatCases.title: Live Σ footer totals closing_stock_amount across all rows
flatCases.preconditions: Backend returns a CSV containing the 'closing_stock_amount' header with multiple numeric rows.
steps: Open a report whose CSV has a closing_stock_amount column (e.g. R7).
Manually add the closing_stock_amount values from the visible rows.
Compare to the Σ figure in the footer.
flatCases.expected: sumColumnIndex resolves to indexOf('closing_stock_amount'); footer shows 'Σ <total>' formatted en-IN currency and countUnit 'Items'. The displayed Σ equals the client-side sum of the column over all rows (note: sum of pre-rounded integers).

flatCases.title: Spreadsheet search filters rows by stock name and recomputes Σ live
flatCases.preconditions: A report with several rows is open in the sheet.
steps: Type a substring of a stock_item_name (row[0]) into the sheet's search box.
Observe the filtered rows and the Σ footer.
flatCases.expected: Only rows whose row[0] (lowercased) contains the query remain visible; the Σ recomputes over only the visible/filtered rows (it is NOT a server-authoritative total). Clearing the search restores all rows and the full Σ.

flatCases.title: Empty report (header-only CSV) renders headers with zero rows and ₹0 Σ
flatCases.preconditions: Backend can return a header-only CSV (e.g. a company with no qualifying stock for that report key). Use a test company or mock to force this.
steps: Open a report key that yields no data rows.
Observe the sheet.
flatCases.expected: CsvToListConverter parses 1 row -> columnLabels set, rows=[] (all-blank lines dropped), footerTrailing '0 rows', Σ shows ₹0 (formatCurrency(0)). The sheet shows headers and no data. No crash.

flatCases.title: Truly empty body (zero bytes) yields a degenerate but non-crashing sheet
flatCases.preconditions: Backend/mock returns an empty 200 body for the report.
steps: Force a 200 response with an empty body (proxy/mock).
Tap the report.
Observe.
flatCases.expected: parsed.isEmpty branch: columnLabels=[], rows=[], columnWidths=[42], footerTrailing=''. The bottom sheet opens degenerate (no columns/rows) without throwing. App does not crash and the spinner clears.

flatCases.title: Fully-blank CSV lines are dropped from the rendered rows
flatCases.preconditions: Backend/mock CSV contains some lines that are entirely empty fields between data rows.
steps: Open a report whose CSV has blank lines interspersed.
Count rendered rows vs CSV data lines.
flatCases.expected: parsed.skip(1).where((r)=>r.any(non-empty)) removes fully-blank rows; only rows with at least one non-empty cell are shown and counted in footerTrailing 'N rows'.

flatCases.title: CSV EOL mismatch leaves a cosmetic trailing CR on the last column only
flatCases.preconditions: Backend joins lines with CRLF; app parses with eol '\n'.
steps: Open any report.
Inspect the last column header/value (scenario_name) for a trailing carriage return artifact (e.g. horizontal-scroll the sheet or share the CSV on mobile and open in an editor).
flatCases.expected: The last field per line (scenario_name and its header) carries a trailing '\r'. Because closing_stock_amount is NOT the last column, indexOf('closing_stock_amount') and the Σ are unaffected. Only cosmetic CR on scenario_name; no functional impact.

flatCases.title: Renaming the closing_stock_amount header silently drops the Σ money figure
flatCases.preconditions: Ability to make the backend emit a different header label for the closing-stock column (e.g. via a backend build with the column renamed) or a mocked CSV.
steps: Force a CSV whose money column is NOT literally named 'closing_stock_amount'.
Open the report.
Inspect the footer.
